target: Add automation tier and approval policy registry
invariants: The registry classifies capabilities only and does not grant approval
Unregistered capabilities fail closed as TU/refuse
T4 and higher capabilities require approval and receipt
Write and destructive capabilities must name the canonical writer
Bridge-mediated writes must name the upstream canonical writer before they can be valid
No PM writes, ConPort writes, dope-memory writes, dope-context index writes, or GitHub mutations are performed

execution.stacked_because: TP-DMX-ORCH-004 depends on TP-DMX-ORCH-001 and TP-DMX-ORCH-003 and reuses the validator/report primitives added by TP-DMX-ORCH-003.

pr.title: feat(orchestrator): add approval policy registry
pr.body: Adds a machine-readable Task Orchestrator automation tier and approval policy registry with read-only validation and inspection helpers.

steps.task: Inspect the operator integration authority tiers, current safety profiles, and existing orchestrator CLI/validator patterns.
validation: Evidence distinguishes the automation tier registry from extraction authority tiers and dangerous mode profiles.

steps.task: Add a machine-readable approval policy registry for T0/T1/T2/T3/T4/T5/T6/TX/TU and the proposed orchestrator capabilities.
validation: All required tiers are present in deterministic order
T4 and higher entries require approval and receipts

steps.task: Implement a pure-read policy loader, validator, and capability classifier.
validation: Invalid T4 receipt configuration fails closed
Write capability without canonical writer fails closed
No command execution or approval application is implemented

steps.task: Expose read-only CLI helpers for policy validation, tier listing, capability listing, and capability classification.
validation: AST guard confirms no execute/write/transition calls in orchestrator command module

steps.task: Create this packet's generated Task Packet and proof artifact.
validation: Generated Task Packet validates against dopetask-canonical-spec.json
Proof artifact validates with dopemux orchestrator proof validate
